what: [research] 28 of the 42 unread e35 units carry NO achieved OOS count at all (`base_oos_trades` null on every row), so the R4 power gate cannot grade them -- and they cannot be back-filled: the source report.json files are workflow artifacts, never committed, and a PM-side session has no artifact download. They are therefore stuck in `unread` indefinitely. The verdict vocabulary (actioned / no_action_warranted / underpowered / superseded) has no member for NEVER MEASURED. Recording them `underpowered` would assert a measurement nobody made -- it means 'measured, and too small' -- so the honest options today are to leave them unread (which reads as nobody looked) or to re-sweep, a multi-hour run the corpus exists to avoid. That is a collapsed state in the vocabulary itself: 'we measured n and it was short' and 'n was never recorded' are different facts with different remedies (acquire more data vs re-run the extractor).
